name: Bubble Pop

description: Turns every website dark (even ones without a dark mode), with a dark glass browser

name: DORFic

name: Frutiger Metro
description: 2000s vector art: sunburst rays, target rings, stars and halftone dots in lime, cyan, hot pink and black

name: Retro 2000

name: Woodland Hut
description: A cozy fantasy cabin in an enchanted forest: carved wood, moss, parchment and lantern light
